description: This file contains implementation of higher-order operations for PyTorch, including functions for tensor redistribution, custom autograd functions, and graph module manipulations related to local mapping and autoparallel execution.

classes.name: LocalMapHOP
classes.description: HigherOrderOperator subclass implementing the 'local_map_hop' operation for graph tracing and execution.

classes.name: LocalMapAutogradOp
classes.description: Custom autograd Function for handling forward and backward passes of local map operations with saved activations and gradients.

methods.name: defer_inlining
methods.description: Context manager to defer inlining during graph tracing.

methods.name: _new_tensor
methods.description: Creates a new tensor with specified shape and stride, supporting subclasses like FunctionalTensor and FakeTensor.

methods.name: redistribute_fw_inputs
methods.description: Redistributes forward pass inputs across device mesh based on placement info.

methods.name: redistribute_fw_outputs
methods.description: Redistributes forward pass outputs, including activations, across device mesh.

methods.name: redistribute_bw_inputs
methods.description: Redistributes backward pass inputs, including gradients and activations, across device mesh.

methods.name: redistribute_bw_outputs
methods.description: Redistributes backward pass outputs across device mesh.

methods.name: create_hop_fw_bw
methods.description: Creates forward and backward graph modules for a local map operation, including partitioning and validation.

methods.name: LocalMapAutogradOp.forward
methods.description: Forward pass of the custom autograd function, saving activations for backward.

methods.name: LocalMapAutogradOp.backward
methods.description: Backward pass of the custom autograd function, computing gradients.

methods.name: autograd_key
methods.description: Dispatch key implementation for autograd mode, handling graph execution.

methods.name: functional_mode_key
methods.description: Dispatch key implementation for functional tensor mode, handling tensor unwrapping and rewrapping.

methods.name: fake_mode_key
methods.description: Dispatch key implementation for FakeTensor mode, handling local shape conversion for autoparallel.

methods.name: proxy_mode_key_common
methods.description: Common logic for proxy mode dispatch keys, handling proxy creation and local map argument propagation.

methods.name: proxy_mode_key
methods.description: Dispatch key implementation for ProxyTorchDispatchMode, wrapping calls with proxy logic.

methods.name: real_impl
methods.description: Implementation for running the graph module in eager mode with real tensors.
